description: This file contains implementation of filesystem utility functions used within the build system, including path normalization, path resolution, and directory handling, primarily for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: BuildDirContext
classes.description: Represents the context for build directory paths, including build settings, toolchain label, and whether it is the default toolchain.

methods.name: BuildDirContext
methods.description: Constructors for BuildDirContext with various parameters such as Target, Settings, Scope, or explicit build settings and labels.

methods.name: GetBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns the build directory as a SourceDir object for a given build directory type.

methods.name: GetBuildDirAsOutputFile
methods.description: Returns the build directory as an OutputFile object for a given build directory type.

methods.name: GetSubBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns a subdirectory within the build directory as a SourceDir, based on source directory and build directory type.

methods.name: GetSubBuildDirAsOutputFile
methods.description: Returns a subdirectory within the build directory as an OutputFile, based on source directory and build directory type.

methods.name: GetBuildDirForTargetAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns the build directory for a specific target as a SourceDir.

methods.name: GetBuildDirForTargetAsOutputFile
methods.description: Returns the build directory for a specific target as an OutputFile.

methods.name: GetScopeCurrentBuildDirAsSourceDir
methods.description: Returns the current build directory for a scope as a SourceDir, depending on build directory type.
